cover.headline: [8] things to check before you [commit] to a girl
cover.sub: (or you'll pay for it for years)

picked.why: Owner pick. Golden-hour genuine warmth, natural relaxed confidence, and authentic presence — exactly the 'good woman' energy for screening before commitment. Soft, trustworthy, real.

slides: A lot of women today aren't searching for love. They're searching for help. Help with the bills. Help with status. Help with a lifestyle they can't afford on their own.
She doesn't want a partner, she wants a problem-solver. Someone to sort out her money, her loneliness and her past mistakes.
3. Help is a deal, not love
Love is a feeling. Help is a trade. And a trade doesn't need loyalty. She'll take your time, your energy, your money and your peace.
4. Watch what happens when you stop
The day you stop helping is the day she stops “loving”. That isn't love. It's a business deal wrapped in emotion.
Once you stop being her solution, you turn into her problem. A woman who sees you as a solution will never see you as a priority.
Modern women want independence, right up until the bills are due. Then traditional values suddenly come back to mind.
7. You are not her rescue plan
You're not a savior. You're not an ATM. You're not a retirement plan.
8. Screen early or pay for years
Men who don't screen carefully pay for the rest of their lives. Not only with money, but with their peace, their freedom and their dignity.
closing: Save this before you get attached.
caption:
Single men, be careful who you choose.

Some women are looking for a fixer, not a partner. Check it early, before it costs you your peace, your freedom and your money.

Have you seen this happen?
